dispatchAnalyzeAvailable: PAYLOAD FIELD. Standalone gates on ptyReady (node-pty availability); the provider hardcodes true. The browser must not advertise dispatch-analyze when PTY is unavailable — a dead-click. Override is deliberate and host-specific.
theme: PAYLOAD FIELD. Standalone emits the switchboardThemeNameSetting entry itself (SURFACES.common — reaches every panel, not just the board) from the resolved theme.name setting via configProvider.getConfigStringWithDefault, with an explicit 'afterburner' fallback. getFullStateMessages does not produce this entry (the provider posts it separately at ready-time). The fallback is commented in bootstrap.ts so a future reader does not mistake a deliberate default for a reinstated hardcode.
autoArchiveConfig: MESSAGE TYPE — delivered by verb return body, not by push. Built by KanbanProvider.autoArchiveGetConfigPayload and returned from the getAutoArchiveConfig verb, which standalone serves through the default: arm. The board receives it as the HTTP response, so no push path is required.
clickupState: MESSAGE TYPE — delivered by verb return body, not by push. Built by KanbanProvider._buildClickUpState and spread into integration verb responses that standalone serves through the default: arm.
linearState: MESSAGE TYPE — delivered by verb return body, not by push. Built by KanbanProvider._buildLinearState and spread into integration verb responses that standalone serves through the default: arm.
remoteConfig: MESSAGE TYPE — delivered by verb return body, not by push. Built and returned by the getRemoteConfig verb, which standalone serves through the default: arm.
overrideState: MESSAGE TYPE — delivered by verb return body, not by push. KanbanProvider builds it with a pure builder and spreads it into the setProjectOverride/setProjectFilter verb responses (PRD contract #4, return-in-body), so the type rides along to the board's existing overrideState handler without a push.
liveSyncUpdate: MESSAGE TYPE — genuinely extension-only. Emitted by ContinuousSyncService, which the standalone composition root does not construct (no reference in src/standalone/). Live-sync progress has no standalone producer; this is a real, accepted gap, not a transport defect. Delete this entry if ContinuousSyncService is ever wired into bootstrap.ts.
